data.name: Car / bike detailing studios: booking + proof page and Google profile upkeep (Gujarat)
data.budget_note: Owner's Apify budget: about US$4-5 a month in total (ledger agent/state/apify_budget.json). No paid sends: the owner messages 1:1 from his own WhatsApp.
data.segment: Owner-run car and bike detailing, coating and PPF studios in Gujarat (Mehsana, Gandhinagar, Ahmedabad first) with a visible gap on their own Google or site page; some already pay for Meta ads that lead to WhatsApp or a call.
data.offer: Booking and proof page (packages by car size, before/after, reviews, WhatsApp Book button), Google profile clean-up and monthly upkeep, WhatsApp Business set-up, source-tagged links, a weekly not-yet-booked enquiry list. About Rs 15-25k setup and about Rs 5k a month (the owner decides; never quoted in messages). Smallest paid step: Rs 5,000 Google + WhatsApp booking tune-up in 3 working days, 50% advance.
evidence_methods: Google Maps scan of 120 Gujarat businesses on 28 Oct 2026: 9 of 11 independent detailing studios had no working own website
Meta Ad Library exact-name checks: 3 of 8 conclusive checks showed an active ad
Independent re-check of 11 named studios on 28 Oct 2026 (10 usable, Exotic Car Detailing held back as a multi-outlet brand)
data.rules: The owner messages 1:1 from his own WhatsApp; nothing is automated. First message = one literally true observation from THEIR own Google or site page + a one-word question; never mention their ads, offers or prices; no price, free, instant, every or guarantee; one message per brand; day-3 follow-up only if the sample already exists; day-7 soft close; STOP is final; 10-12 new chats a day at most from one number; stop and review at 2 blocks. A website is NOT the pitch: sell the booking + proof page and profile upkeep.
data.validation_plan: PRE-REGISTERED 28 Oct 2026. Gate 1 Thu 5 Nov 18:00, n = 46 sends (Thu 29 Oct 10, Fri 30 12, Sat 31 12, Mon 2 Nov 12; delivered >= 36): PASS R >= 8 and Q >= 4; KEEP GOING R >= 4 and Q >= 2; PIVOT R <= 3 or Q <= 1 (batch 2 = wedding vendors); KILL R = 0. Gate 2 Fri 27 Nov, n about 96: PASS >= 1 advance of Rs 5,000 or more; KEEP 0 advance but >= 3 calls or demos; PIVOT <= 2 calls and R >= 5; KILL <= 2 calls and R <= 4. No cold sends 6-15 Nov (Diwali about 8 Nov). R = any human reply, Q = owner says the gap matters or asks what / how much, C = call or demo.
